# Heuristics Workshop

**Speakers/Facilitators:** G. Kennedy, H. Lee (plus others TBD)

## Abstract
This workshop introduces the INCOSE heuristics initiative and focuses on developing pragmatic HSI heuristics that clarify value and dispel misconceptions.

## Discussion Seeds
- HSI misconceptions
- Candidate heuristics from primer + LLM
- Synthesis for database submission
